intro: Review what you've learned about resistance to refactoring.

questions.prompt: What does resistance to refactoring mean for automated tests?

options.text: How well a test detects internal implementation changes
How fast tests run after code cleanup
How many refactorings occur before a test fails
How well a test suite stays green after refactoring that preserves behavior

questions.prompt: Which type of test is more likely to produce false positives?

options.text: A test that asserts inputs and outputs from the user's perspective
A test that checks observable behavior through public APIs or UI interactions
A test that checks specific internal steps, components, or intermediate states
A test that fails only when business rules change
